items.title: fix(server): reject routers with incompatible procedure context
items.body:
## Summary
- carry the base context type on built procedure definitions
- validate router inputs so procedures, routers, and lazy routers require a context satisfied by the parent router
- add a regression test for mixing procedures from incompatible `initTRPC.context()` roots

Fixes #4306

## Tests
- pnpm.cmd test packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/router.test.ts packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/procedureBuilder.test.ts packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/router.mergeRouters.test.ts --run
- pnpm.cmd exec prettier --check packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/procedure.ts packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/procedureBuilder.ts packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/router.ts packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/router.test.ts packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/router.mergeRouters.test.ts

Note: `pnpm.cmd --filter @trpc/server typecheck` still fails locally in `src/adapters/ws.ts` because the installed `ws` typings are resolved without `ws.WebSocket` / `ws.WebSocketServer` namespace members in this environment. No errors from the router/procedure context changes remain before that unrelated failure.

items.title: new way to integrate AsyncLocalStorage
items.body:
This PR addresses the feature request here https://github.com/trpc/trpc/issues/6870

## Problem Statement

Currently, integrating AsyncLocalStorage with tRPC requires:

1. Manual context passing
2. Global procedure middleware wrapping

This creates unnecessary boilerplate for a common need.

## Solution

Add optional `asyncStorage` to runtime config that automatically wraps all procedures to improve developer experience.

### Why Runtime Configuration?

- **Architectural Fit**: Async context is a runtime concern, not request context
- **Backward Compatible**: Optional parameter maintains existing behavior
- **Clean DX**: Single configuration point vs middleware wiring

## Implementation

### Propagation Path

1. Run time config → Root config → Procedure builder → Resolver → Procedure caller
2. Preserves full type safety throughout
3. inject context into the storage for type safety

## Key Considerations

### Performance

- Minimal overhead (AsyncLocalStorage is optimized for this)
- Only active when configured
- short-circuit pattern  run the async storage on the same index as middleware chain

### Advanced Use Cases

- **Nested Procedures**: Automatically inherit storage
- **Overrides**: Still possible via manual `.use()` wrapping with not passing asyncStorage as runtime configuration
- **Middleware**: Runs within storage context

## Usage Example

```tsx
const storage = new AsyncLocalStorage();
const t = initTRPC.create({
  asyncStorage: storage 
});

// Any procedure automatically has context storage
const router = t.router({
  getUser: t.procedure.query(() => {
    deepFunction(); // Can access context via storage.getStore()
  })
});

```

## Alternatives Considered

1. **Context-Based**: Rejected - wrong abstraction l[a](http://async-context-management.md/)yer
2. **Plugin System**: Overkill -  focused use case
3. **Global Middleware**: existing solution before this with .use on a procedure  

## Final note :

- I have also updated the documentation and added example for this, as new concept in docs docs/server/[a](http://a[sync-context-management.md](http://sync-context-management.md/)/)sync-context-management.md

## ✅ Checklist

- [ x] I have followed the steps listed in the [Contributing guide](https://github.com/trpc/trpc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x ] If necessary, I have added documentation related to the changes made.
- [x ] I have added or updated the tests related to the changes made.
